#### 1. bilateral parasagittal parieto-occipital polymicrogyria  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.716)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:16873)

**Proposed mechanism:** PIKFYVE (HGNC:16873) —DISRUPTS→ Endosomal trafficking and lysosomal function (GO:0005770); Endosomal trafficking and lysosomal function (GO:0005770) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal cerebral cortex development (HP:0033701); Endosomal trafficking and lysosomal function (GO:0005770) —LEADS_TO→ Polymicrogyria (HP:0001302). Loss-of-function mutations in PIKFYVE disrupt endosomal trafficking and lysosomal function, leading to distinct but related phenotypes of abnormal cerebral cortex development (MONDO:0012640) and polymicrogyria (MONDO:0012986).

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in PIKFYVE that are exclusively associated with one disease and not the other, or evidence that the shared mechanism does not involve PIKFYVE. _(variant: rs755208420)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of PIKFYVE in these distinct rare neurological disorders could lead to the development of targeted therapies that address common downstream pathways, potentially benefiting patients with either condition.
